roles.name: Programmatic QA
roles.description: Runs programmatic scenario QA checks and creates backlog items for actionable structural issues.

roles.name: Architectural Auditor
roles.description: Investigates scenarios through architectural and testing lenses to surface non-programmatic quality findings.

roles.name: Bug Investigator
roles.description: Drains bug-inbox/* (universal-source intake — any team's members may file via the report-bug skill), applies a registered investigation technique from docs/scenario-qa/investigation-techniques/, and closes each entry with a bug-investigation/<slug> audit-log entry naming the technique applied and outcome taken.

roles.name: QA Contrarian
roles.description: Cross-cutting skeptic for scenario-qa. Reads peer-member outputs (bug-investigations, audits, readiness backlog) and writes challenge-note/* entries citing specific failure modes from the technique registries. Does not generate positive-action proposals.
